mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_chat_session (session_no, user_id, session_title, knowledge_domain, latest_question, latest_answer, message_count, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{sessionNo}, #{userId}, #{sessionTitle}, #{knowledgeDomain}, #{latestQuestion}, #{latestAnswer}, #{messageCount}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_chat_session SET session_no = #{sessionNo}, user_id = #{userId}, session_title = #{sessionTitle}, knowledge_domain = #{knowledgeDomain}, latest_question = #{latestQuestion}, latest_answer = #{latestAnswer}, message_count = #{messageCount}, status = #{status}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
